The refactor in `src/cart.js` is done, and `test/cart.test.js` passes (3/3). I didn't run the full suite, as you asked. I haven't committed anything, so the change is only in the working tree.

What changed:

- **`lineTotal(item)`** (new, exported): returns `item.price * item.qty`.
- **`total(items)`**: now `items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + lineTotal(item), 0)`. It uses quantities, and an empty cart returns `0`.
- **`applyDiscount(amount, pct)`**: rounds the result to 2 decimals with `Math.round(x * 100) / 100`. Half-up rounding, so `10.005` becomes `10.01`.

Quick spot checks: `total([])` gives `0`, `total` with `{price: 2, qty: 3}` and `{price: 1.5, qty: 2}` gives `9`, and `applyDiscount(19.99, 15)` gives `16.99`.

Two things to be aware of:

- `total` now multiplies by `qty` with no default, so an item without a `qty` field gives `NaN`. The existing test data always sets `qty`, but any other caller that omits it will break. If that case exists, tell me and I'll default it to 1.
- I only ran `test/cart.test.js`. I didn't check whether other test files exist beyond it, and CI will cover the rest.
